name: oifs_mcp
description: Single-file containerized POSIX inode filesystem MCP server with optional XAES-256-GCM encryption, Zstd/SIMD compression, CRC32C WAL, atomic WriteBatch, and bounded pagination.

cleanExitExport: oifs mount <mnt> (pure-Rust FUSE ABI v7.28 or zero-kext NFSv3)
oifs cat / ls / info CLI extraction

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read bounded UTF-8 file contents (default 256 KiB cap, supports offset and max_bytes).

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List directory entries as JSONL with pagination (default 500, max 5000 via offset and limit).

tools.name: stat_path
tools.description: Inspect inode metadata, size, compressed_size, timestamps, encryption, and seekable flags.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Show container path, byte size, read-only/auto-grow state, Zstd dicts, block usage, and fragmentation.

tools.name: verify_integrity
tools.description: Run online structural fsck consistency check across inodes, directories, and bitmaps.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a UTF-8 file inside the sandbox container.

tools.name: append_file
tools.description: Mutex-serialized newline-terminated append (ideal for JSONL agent logs).

tools.name: mkdir
tools.description: Create a directory inside the sandbox container.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the sandbox container.

tools.name: truncate_file
tools.description: Truncate or zero-extend a file to target byte length.

tools.name: rename_path
tools.description: Atomic POSIX rename/move with SIV filename re-encryption.

tools.name: write_batch
tools.description: Commit mixed create_file/mkdir/delete/rename operations in one atomic WAL transaction.

tools.name: resize_image
tools.description: Online grow/shrink container bytes (in-place or inode-preserving AtomicRelayout).

tools.name: vacuum_image
tools.description: Reclaim trailing free space and compact sparse gaps.

tools.name: configure_auto_grow
tools.description: Enable/disable or tune transparent capacity expansion with optional max_size_bytes cap.

tools.name: train_zstd_dict
tools.description: Train a custom Zstd dictionary from directory samples inside the container.

tools.name: load_zstd_dict
tools.description: Load and register a trained Zstd dictionary stored inside the container.

tools.name: set_default_zstd_dict
tools.description: Set or clear the active default Zstd dictionary ID on this mount.
